evidence.why: Unchecked constructor result and exact randomization branches.
Constructor failure, successful publication and shared-state entry writes.

facts.rationale: Corrects unconditional-success wording and preserves the cross-file construction/publication failure branch instead of assuming a freshly created manager always exists.
facts.value: Always attempts grZakoGenerator_801CAE04(NULL), ignoring its return. A zero zako_spawn_chance bypasses RNG and takes the optional reserved-entry setup branch; a nonzero bound is passed to HSD_Randi and setup is called only when the result is zero. There is no local validation of negative bounds. Manager creation is not guaranteed: on GObj creation failure the constructor frees its allocated data and returns NULL without publishing the new manager pointer. This caller nevertheless continues, and optional setup dereferences shared generator state without a local success check.

evidence.why: Timer initialization, independent follow/timer branches and collision guards.

facts.rationale: Replaces the unsupported timed player-follow phase/camera-mode interpretation and preserves numeric collision-state ambiguity.
facts.value: Initializes component 1's countdown from camera_timer and registers the joint-1 collision handler. The recurring callback follows P1 independently of that countdown: positive values decrement, while values already zero or negative cause repeated Camera_RequestQuake(QuakeKind_Loop, NULL) calls without further decrement. The collision handler sets stage_info.flags bit 0x10 only when coll->x34_flags.b1234 equals 1, the colliding GObj matches P1 and ground_kind equals 1. These numeric guards do not by themselves establish collision-direction or route-completion semantics, and there is no local bit-clear path.

facts.rationale: Corrects the stale camera callee/mode description while preserving exact position and timer flow, including the absent-fighter branch.
facts.value: Copies the route's player_pos into a local vector, obtains Ground_GetP1Fighter(), and, only when a fighter exists, calls ftLib_80086644 to obtain its position, clamps Y to at least -50, forces X to zero and submits X/Y to Ground_801C38BC. The initial local vector is not submitted as a fallback when no fighter exists. Independently reads u.zebes2.xC4, decrementing positive values or calling Camera_RequestQuake(QuakeKind_Loop, NULL) for nonpositive values. Calls lb_800115F4 on every invocation.

evidence.why: Parameterized countdown, independent vertical following and looping-quake request.

facts.rationale: Retains the existing stage context but replaces the unsupported camera-mode transition with the effect explicitly requested by canonical code.
facts.value: Provides Zebes Route's vertically player-following stage-camera offset and delayed looping-quake requests during the ascent associated with Brinstar Escape Shaft. The local parameterized countdown gates quake requests; it neither ends player following nor establishes the Adventure objective's overall time limit.

facts.rationale: The canonical call requests a quake, not camera mode 1; the existing recurring-component role remains correct.
facts.value: Runs Ground component 1's recurring update: conditionally follows P1 with a vertically clamped stage-camera offset, decrements a positive countdown or requests a looping quake when it is nonpositive, and invokes lb_800115F4 after either branch.

evidence.why: Independent fighter guard and mutually exclusive timer branches.

facts.rationale: Corrects the post-expiration effect and makes the branch boundary explicit without claiming how the camera subsystem deduplicates or realizes repeated requests.
facts.value: Without P1's fighter, leaves the camera offset unchanged through this callback. With a fighter, forces X to zero and follows Y with a lower clamp of -50. Independently decrements the countdown once when positive; a transition from one to zero does not request a quake on that invocation. When the value is already zero or negative, leaves it unchanged and calls Camera_RequestQuake(QuakeKind_Loop, NULL) on that and every subsequent invocation unless another writer changes the timer. Player following continues independently of expiration.

facts.rationale: Corrects the TU-level camera-mode claim while retaining the parameter producers, consumers and broader controller responsibilities.
facts.value: Initialization caches the two-field Yakumono parameter block before configuring Ground objects 0 through 2 and establishes stage flags. zako_spawn_chance controls the zero-result guard around optional shared-generator entry setup; camera_timer seeds component 1's countdown. Component 1 conditionally sends P1's vertically clamped position to the stage-camera offset setter and independently decrements the countdown or requests QuakeKind_Loop when it is nonpositive. Its registered collision handler can OR bit 0x10 into stage_info.flags. Load-time lighting consumes the unit's fixed spatial vectors and a Ground-provided scale.

facts.rationale: Removes stale camera-mode and collision-direction interpretations while preserving numeric guards, independent branches and flag lifetime uncertainty.
facts.value: Component 1 starts with a parameterized countdown. Positive values decrement; values already zero or negative repeatedly request Camera_RequestQuake(QuakeKind_Loop, NULL) without further decrement. Independently, a present P1 fighter supplies a camera-offset target with X=0 and Y clamped to at least -50; without a fighter no offset is submitted. The joint collision callback ORs stage flag 0x10 only for b1234 category value 1, P1 GObj identity and ground_kind value 1. The callback does not clear the bit, and its local code does not establish that the bit means completion.
